quotes.speaker: Darius Garland
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Garland on his trade from Cleveland to Chicago
quotes.excerpt: I was in Cleveland for five years and then traded to the Chicago Bulls.
quotes.quote: I have only been traded once. I was in Cleveland for five years and then traded to the Chicago Bulls, the team I am currently on. The story for me on how I got traded, I think it was a Saturday. I was in a hot Pilates class, getting a workout in. I did not bring my phone into the class. I actually have two phones, and my business phone I left in my car. I get out of the class and my agent was trying to call me. He had called one of my friends, and once my friend said he was calling, I knew I definitely got traded. I came out of the class sweaty, everything sweaty, and I was traded.

quotes.speaker: Darius Garland
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Garland on guarding Darius Garland and Donovan Mitchell
quotes.excerpt: I love them boys to death, love Darius, love Donovan, but they know what my answer is.
quotes.quote: I love them boys to death, love Darius, love Donovan, but they know what my answer is. I am locking both of them up, so it really does not matter. It does not matter. I have gotten to learn both of their games by playing against them in practice, so it does not matter.

quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Garland on never seeing Josh Giddey in the weight room
quotes.excerpt: I do not think I have ever walked into the weight room, locker room, or anything. I do not think I have ever seen Josh on the ox.
quotes.quote: I do not think I have ever walked into the weight room, locker room, or anything. I do not think I have ever seen Josh on the ox. I do not think I have ever heard any of his music before. I think I am going to go with Josh. I do not think I have ever heard him on the ox before.
